note: Initial policy value (word-overlap Jaccard of the statements), not calibrated. A closed hypothesis is equivalent to a new one when they share an identity (trial id, hypothesis id, frozen family) or when the lexical similarity reaches the threshold. Embedding similarity has no calibrated threshold (Prompt 7 measured 0.65-0.75 between a new statement and every closed crypto hypothesis), so it only ranks matches for review and never decides. Changing a threshold is a new version file, merged by the owner.
